event_timeline.event: Coinbase Q3 reporting period ended; all Q3 balance and operating metrics predate the RLUSD Coinbase listing.
Coinbase made RLUSD available across Prime, Exchange and Retail, with deposits/withdrawals on XRPL, Base and Ethereum; Global Exchange collateral functionality was described as future.
Coinbase published Q3 2026 results and reported record average USDC held in its products, market-share gains and prediction-market growth.

findings.statement: Coinbase reported average USDC held in Coinbase products of $22B in Q3 2026, approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization and 49% higher year over year.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: This is an average platform-balance measure, not net external capital; it is a company-defined metric and the reporting period ended before the October 28 RLUSD listing.

findings.statement: Coinbase reported 10.7% crypto trading-volume market share, its fourth consecutive quarter of gains, and 12.5% share of total crypto market capitalization in Assets on Platform.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: These are company-reported aggregate Coinbase metrics, not XRP-specific spot share, XRP custody balances or independent market-share measurements.

findings.statement: Coinbase reported crypto derivatives trading volume compound annual growth of 179% over two years and prediction markets exceeding $200M in annualized revenue, with 82% quarterly compound growth since launch.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The 179% figure is a two-year growth rate and the $200M figure is an annualized run rate, not Q3 recognized prediction-market revenue; neither establishes XRP-specific derivatives demand.

findings.statement: Coinbase reported Q3 GAAP net income of $718.7M, adjusted net income of $77.7M and adjusted EBITDA of $332.9M. The earnings release attributes a substantial difference between GAAP and adjusted results to gains on crypto assets held for investment.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: Adjusted measures are non-GAAP and management-defined; they should supplement, not replace, GAAP results.

findings.statement: Coinbase's Q3 2026 SEC filing states that its arrangement with Circle Internet Financial was renewed on the same terms. The same filing reports Q3 stablecoin revenue of $306.905M versus $324.534M in Q3 2025, with higher average USDC balances adding $84.6M and lower average interest rates reducing revenue by $52.8M.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The filing does not disclose post-October 28 RLUSD balances or any change in Circle's distribution economics after the RLUSD listing.

findings.statement: Coinbase's Q3 results plus its October 28 RLUSD launch are consistent with a multi-issuer distribution strategy: Circle/USDC economics continue while Ripple/RLUSD gains a new Coinbase distribution channel. The evidence does not show that RLUSD displaced USDC.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The Q3 USDC metrics predate the RLUSD listing, and no comparable post-launch USDC/RLUSD balance or volume series is yet available.

findings.statement: The net new external capital attributable to Coinbase's Q3 USDC balance growth, and any post-listing substitution between USDC and RLUSD, cannot be calculated from the disclosed metrics.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: No transaction-level customer inflow/outflow, beneficial-owner or post-listing balance decomposition is disclosed.

findings.statement: Coinbase's diversified revenue mix may reduce dependence on spot trading cycles over time, but Q3 results still show material transaction-revenue exposure; this is a business-model hypothesis, not an XRP price signal.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: Q3 transaction revenue was $590.2M versus approximately $1.0B a year earlier, and total revenue was materially lower year over year.

causal_hypotheses.name: Coinbase multi-issuer distribution expansion
causal_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase is broadening stablecoin distribution while retaining Circle/USDC economics and adding Ripple/RLUSD.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: No post-listing balances, revenue split or RLUSD/USDC substitution data; Q3 USDC figures predate RLUSD launch.

causal_hypotheses.name: RLUSD displaces USDC on Coinbase
causal_hypotheses.claim: RLUSD could compete for Coinbase stablecoin balances, trading activity and institutional settlement over time.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Coinbase renewed the Circle arrangement on the same terms and reported record Q3 USDC balances before RLUSD became available; no post-launch displacement evidence.

causal_hypotheses.name: Coinbase revenue diversification reduces spot-cycle sensitivity
causal_hypotheses.claim: Derivatives, subscriptions, stablecoins, lending and prediction markets may make Coinbase less dependent on spot trading cycles.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Transaction revenue remained $590.2M in Q3 and fell substantially year over year; company-wide diversification does not eliminate market-cycle exposure.

causal_hypotheses.name: RLUSD adoption creates material XRP buying demand
causal_hypotheses.claim: More RLUSD settlement on XRPL could indirectly increase XRP use through fees, account reserves, AMM liquidity or bridge transactions.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: RLUSD is the announced settlement asset; XRP bridge use is optional and not demonstrated by Coinbase listing or C2FO announcements. No incremental XRP acquisition, AMM execution or net reserve demand is measured.

prediction_contract.reason: Coinbase Q3 issuer-reported business metrics are structural/event context and are not validated as predictive XRP features. No fixed-horizon out-of-sample signal is available.
